title: Gale's Combat Gyro
overview: Jin and three other fighter Nado players come as special Nados that drop down from the sky. While looking for the owner of the special Nado, Jin comes across Dawn. Have these two met before?

title: Reunion of friends
overview: Jin and Dawn decide to meet Cecila to find out if she knows about the strange bond the three of them share. However, with Cecila being a famous Nado fighter, will they be able to meet her with ease?

title: Nado crisis
overview: Jin, Davis, Dawn and Cecila go meet Dr Louis and learn more about their Nados. However, the King family plots to attack the research lab and steal all the special equipment held there. Will Jin be able to defend Dr Louis?

title: Mysterious thief Dodd
overview: Phantom thief Dodd steals a powerful Nado and claims to be keeping it safe till he finds a suitable owner who can use it. Will Jin confront the mysterious thief for stealing the Thunder Stallion Nado?

title: Tacit understanding test
overview: Dr. Louis reveals that the spirit of Hellish Ghost has arrived on Earth and the space between dimensions is expanding and could result in the Nado's of the world getting destroyed. Furthermore Jin decides to look for Hellish ghost. Will Jin succeed?

title: The King family
overview: A mysterious individual makes an appearance before the King family and hands them a powerful Nado, tasking them with defeating Jin and stealing his Nado. Will Jin be able to defeat the mysterious new Nado?

title: Fighting On The Highwire
overview: A player from the Lengend 9, Mach Skyrider arrives in Cyclone City for a competition. Jin and the others join Mach to the arena. However, Mach seems to be hiding something from Jin and the others. Will Jin find out what Mach is hiding?

title: Ultra accelerating contest
overview: Jin begins to suspect that Dodd the Phantom Thief could have some connection to Hellish Ghost. However, Jin learns that Dodd is after Hellish Ghost too. Will Jin and the others join hands with Dodd to find out more about Hellish Ghost?

title: First battle with flare star
overview: Mach wins the competition and gets ready to leave. However, Jin begins asking Mach about the connection between Hellish Ghost and the Lengend 9. Will Mach give Jin the answers he is looking for about Hellish Ghost?

title: Fight for airship
overview: While Jin flies his airship with Nedo Drive Automatic system, Bill and his accomplices try to capture it mid-air with a full fledged plan. Will they be successful in their attempt?

title: Union of Brothers and Sisters
overview: While an overzealous Jin roams around the city with his friends, he is overwhelmed upon seeing Rachael's posters all over. Meanwhile, as he encounters her during the competition, he challenges her.

title: Battled caused by cooking
overview: Cecilia tells Jin that they should compete as a team to win the competition. Jin develops a new Nedo replacing the tip with "Glittering Butterfly". But still he is not sure if it is a correct defensive model to stop the Ballistic Fox. Will Jin develop a different model for that?

title: Split between brother and sister
overview: A tough competition takes place between Jin's Nedo with Glittering Butterfly tip and the Assaultic Fox. Rachelle is totally aback at this and puts more power to her Nedo. Will Jin be able to win this time?

title: Siege of train
overview: Jin, Dawn, Cecilia and Davis board a train for their next competition in Whirlpool city. Bill and his accomplices plan to siege the train after cutting off its power supply. Will Bill be successful in his evil attempt?

title: The clown's magic rhapsody
overview: Jin and his gang enter Whirlpool city and is amazed to se the advancement of technology there. But soon all four of them are captured by detective Jack by mistake, who is actually looking for Phantom thief. Will Jan and his team face Phantom thief?

title: Ancient power
overview: Eli, Dawn, Davis, and Cecilia meet a strange man named Goatson, the manager while looking for a way to face Dodd. Goatson shows them the remains of the first Nado which is believed to hold mysterious powers. Will this help them defeat Dodd?

title: Counterattack of Dodd
overview: After getting defeated by the Elf, Dodd comes back with a stronger and more powerful Nado to challenge him once again for a battle. Will he be able to finally beat the Elf?

title: Combination of wisdom
overview: Eli, Dawn, Davis, and Cecilia meet Detective Shack who is in search of a Hellish Ghost and is helping Goatson with a secret project. Eli and his friends decide to take his help and ask him to join their team. Will Shack join them?

title: The scary Nado battle
overview: After losing all their memories, Jin, Dawn, Davis and Cecilia seek shelter in a mansion during their journey. However, they land into trouble with some elves. Can the foursome save themselves?

title: Unsteady melody
overview: Jin, Dawn, Davis and Cecilia arrive at a village and meet Yvette, a violinist, during their search for the hellish ghost. Soon they realise that Yevette holds a clue to find the hellish ghost. Will they be able to get the information from him?

title: Hidden scars
overview: Dawn battles Vyette and Susan and takes on their deadly fusion Nado. Does Dawn have a hidden strategy to defeat two opponents or will he find himself in a tough spot?

title: Adventurer in Tobin Tower
overview: Jin and his friends come across Jet in an underground battle stadium and decide to challenge him. However, after Dawn gets defeated by Jet, Jin rises to the challenge and takes on Jet. Will Jin be able to win?

title: Reunion Of Old Friends
overview: As Jin and his friends enter Metal Town for the competition, they're chased by robots. Later, inventor Nobe greets his competitors wholeheartedly and explains to them the situation in Metal Town.

title: A Lone Nado
overview: Noob goes up against Cicilia in an ultimate showdown. And her friends gather to support her in the battle of a lifetime. Will Cicilia's nado emerge victoriously?

title: Dominator Of Darkness
overview: Noob and his gang meet a scientist in an effort to learn more about Nado and its secret components so that they can defeat their opponents with ease.

title: The Truth Across Time
overview: Jin finds himself in a predicament when Holy Whisker gets beat up badly in the battle, but he refuses to back down. However, he is determined to win the battle.

title: The Real Identity Of Dodd
overview: Jin is shaken to the core on learning that Holy Whisker has fallen into the wrong hands. So he decides to get it back at any cost. How will Jin retrieve Holy Whisker?

title: Return To The Past
overview: Jin inquires to his friend at the headquarters about the relationship between legging nine and Helisko. So his friend takes him to the past to show how it all began.

title: The Emergence of Flare Star Nado
overview: While Jun wakes up from his slumber, Dawn, Cecilia, Davis and the others are shocked to see a giant light in the skies. Upon inspection, they find an unconscious child with eight Nados protecting him. Who is this child? Find out in this episode.

title: The Conflict between Jett And Mach
overview: After completing one thousand battles, Jett and Mach decide to go for one more battle to see who is the best. But Jin is shocked to learn about the event. Who will win the battle?

title: Little Noe on Earth
overview: Little Noe wants to go back to his parallel world but Tempress Ares stands as an obstruction. How will Jin help Little Noe to go back?

title: Disappearance Of Jun
overview: Jin disappears and goes back seven years behind time. Nobe says that he will be forgotten soon by everyone but he offers help. How will Jin's friends bring him back?

title: Break Into Another Dimension
overview: Jin comes back and Bill challenges him. But he doesn't accept the challenge and starts looking for Dawn, Cecilia, Davis and others. How will Jin find out his friends?

title: Lost In Amusement Park
overview: Jin goes to another dimension to look for his friends and has various experiences. He finds Pandora in an amusement park and both decide to find the exit and look for their other friends. How would Jin and Pandora find out their lost friends?

title: The Battle Of Meteroites
overview: Jin meets Word Ares and Justice Ares who decide to teach Temperance Ares a lesson. The ask Jack about her but he refuses to open his mouth. How will they come to know about Temperance?

title: The Battle Of Mechanical Planets
overview: Trapped in another dimension, Dawn faces a tough opponent who uses a unique and modified version of Hellish Ghost. Will Dawn be able to defeat Temperance and escape?

title: The Battle Of Water Space
overview: Temperance appears before Davis in the underwater dimension and challenges him to a battle. Will Davis and his Nado be able to defeat Temperance's fusion Nado?

title: The Battle Of Fire Space
overview: After losing to Dawn and Davis, Temperance sets her sights on Cecelia and plans to defeat her in a Nado battle. However, will Cecelia receive help from her friends?

title: The Final Battle In Another Dimension
overview: Jin faces Temperance in an epic Nado battle to save Dawn, Davis and Cecelia. However, Temperance has a secret strategy to fight Jin. Can Jin defeat Temperance despite the setbacks?

title: A New Journey
overview: Noticing the difference in strength, Temperance mocks Jin and his power of friendship. Is this the end for Jin and his Nado? Or will his emotions give rise to new powers?

title: Like the legend of the wind
